name: cosil_rq3_repair_top15_k10_v4
rerank_test_policy: candidate-independent generated tests are not yet available for this dataset; official F2P/P2P tests are never used for candidate selection
notes: CoSIL RQ3 downstream repair alignment for a localization comparison: upstream ranked files/functions, one stochastic fine function+line localization, shared localized context, one greedy plus nine stochastic repair candidates, CoSIL-style reasoning and SEARCH/REPLACE output, localized-scope and exact-application validation, language-aware syntax validation where deterministic standard-library parsers exist, changed-content normalization, deterministic majority reranking, and one final official evaluation. Top-15 means up to 15 available ranked files; no rank is fabricated. Sampling geometry is frozen explicitly: top_p=1.0 for localization and all repair candidates. Output budgets remain 8192 for Qwen3.5 reasoning compatibility. Original CoSIL requested 20 repair samples but its public reranking path consumed only candidates 0-9; this protocol directly generates those 10 effective candidates and avoids 10 paid discarded responses. The original CoSIL generated reproduction/regression reranker is not imitated with official benchmark tests because that would leak final evaluation evidence; its absence is explicit in rerank_test_policy.
